translated_text: The names of the Deities that were born in the Plain of High Heaven when the Heaven and Earth began were the Deity Master-of-the-August-Center-of-Heaven, next, the High-August-Producing-Wondrous-Deity, next, the Divine-Producing-Wondrous-Deity.
original_text: 天地初發之時、於高天原成神名、天之御中主神。次高御産巣日神。次神産巣日神。

translated_text: These three Deities were all Deities born alone, and hid their persons.
original_text: 此三柱神者、並獨神成坐而隱身也。

translated_text: The names of the Deities that were born next from a thing that sprouted up like unto a reed-shoot when the earth, young and like unto floating oil, drifted about medusa-like, were the Pleasant-Reed-Shoot-Prince-Elder-Deity, next the Heavenly-Eternally-Standing-Deity.
original_text: 次國稚如浮脂而、久羅下那州多陀用幣琉之時、如葦牙因萌騰之物而成神名、宇摩志阿斯訶備比古遲神。次天之常立神。

translated_text: These two Deities were likewise born alone, and hid their persons.
original_text: 此二柱神亦、獨神成坐而隱身也。

translated_text: The five Deities in the above list are separate Heavenly Deities.
